title: Vectors: Rule 2 test cases
description: Create test vectors for Rule 2. Acceptance: covers edge cases, used by all implementations.
close_reason: SATISFIED by test/vectors/schc_compression.json Rule-2 additions (both derived from the Python oracle, never hand-invented): (1) EDGE icmpv6_echo_reply — Echo Reply type=129 id=0x1234 seq=42 payload 'pong' round-trips under rule 2, proving the VALUE_SENT ICMPv6.type discriminator carries both Echo values (128 request already covered; 129 was not); compressed 024000000000000000010000000000000002811234002a706f6e67. (2) ERROR icmpv6_echo_truncated_residue — category=malformed, residue cut to 21 of 22 bytes (02400000000000000001000000000000000280abcd00), decompress MUST reject (Python SchcError 'packet too short'; Rust BitReader TooShort). NOTE: nonzero-padding negatives are structurally impossible for rule 2 (residue is exactly 176 bits, byte-aligned) unlike rules 0/1/5/6; the crafted-residue wrong-type negative is a REAL divergence (Python rejects via post-build profile.matches(), Rust accepts unvalidated) and was filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-s9e2 instead of adding a false vector. Machine-consumed by python/tests/test_vectors.py::test_schc_vector + ::test_all_schc_rules_covered and rust/lichen-schc/tests/shared_vectors.rs::test_schc_compression_vectors.
